items.title: EU’s new pharma package an “opportunity missed” industry says
items.summary: The European Commission’s range of competitiveness-boosting measures aim to close the biopharma innovation and funding gap to global rivals.

items.title: MASH market expected to reach $17.7bn across the 7MM by 2035
items.summary: The MASH market across the 7MM is set to grow from $1.5bn in 2025 to $17.7bn in 2035, at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 28%.

items.title: German PEI approves two Stallergenes’ allergy therapies for paediatric use
items.summary: Germany’s PEI has approved paediatric indication extensions for Stallergenes Greer’s Staloral 3 Trees and Staloral Birch SLIT treatments.

items.title: CGT: Bottlenecks slowing development
items.summary: Safety concerns and complex manufacturing bottlenecks have curtailed funding across CGT, forcing several developers to wind down operations.

items.title: Hetero starts lenacapavir rollout for HIV prevention in Africa
items.summary: Hetero has commenced phased shipments of generic injectable lenacapavir for HIV prevention to Africa, dispatching an initial batch of 300,000 vials across Uganda, Zambia, and Zimbabwe.
